newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha falls $2 as crude, gasoline falter aga.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha falls $2 as crude, gasoline falter aga.

text.p: NWE naphtha slipped again on Wednesday, losing $2 a tonne, tracking weaker crude oil and gasoline.
Dealers said the market remained in gentle contango with June talking $183.50 and July $184.50.
Good supplies from the Med and poor prompt demand kept a lid on physical prices which have struggled to match swaps prices all week.
Turkish and Greek cargoes were heard weighing on the Mediterranean market which talked around $180 cif basis Italy, said dealers.
